use default

let size = 4
let board = (1::16) |> collect_list()

show() is
    for row in 0..size do
        let cells = board |> skip(row * size) |> take(size)

        write_line(cells |> map(n => "{n,3}") |> join(""))
    od
si

solved() -> bool => board |> index() |> all(c => c.value == c.index + 1)

rotate(cells: List[int], forward: bool) is
    let values = cells |> map(i => board[i]) |> collect_list()
    let count = values.count

    for (k, cell) in cells |> index() do
        let from =
            if forward then (k + count - 1) % count else (k + 1) % count fi

        board[cell] = values[from]
    od
si

apply(command: string) -> bool is
    if command.length != 2 \/ !char.is_digit(command[1]) then
        return false
    fi

    let n = cast int(command[1]) - cast int('1')

    if n < 0 \/ n >= size then
        return false
    fi

    let row = (0..size) |> map(c => n * size + c) |> collect_list()
    let column = (0..size) |> map(r => r * size + n) |> collect_list()

    case char.to_upper(command[0])
    when 'R' then rotate(row, true)
    when 'L' then rotate(row, false)
    when 'D' then rotate(column, true)
    when 'U' then rotate(column, false)
    else return false
    esac

    true
si

let random = System.Random(16)
let letters = "LRUD"

for _ in 0..3 do
    let move = "{letters[random.next(4)]}{random.next(size) + 1}"

    apply(move)
od

write_line("Rotate a row with Ln or Rn, a column with Un or Dn,")
write_line("n from 1 to 4.")
write_line("")

show()

let moves mut = 0

while !solved() do
    IO.Std.write("> ")

    let line = IO.Std.read_line()

    if !line? then
        write_line("")
        write_line("given up after {moves} moves")
        break
    fi

    write_line(line)

    if apply(line.trim()) then
        moves = moves + 1
        show()
    else
        write_line("not a move: {line}")
    fi
od

if solved() then
    write_line("solved in {moves} moves")
fi
